description: Reviewed sub-24px (WCAG 2.5.8 AA floor) interactive targets per route at 390px, read by tests/e2e/specs/mobile-target-size.spec.js. On a project listed in recordedOn, a signature this list does not hold FAILS that route's test (by more than the spec's 1px tolerance); a listed signature a run did not see is reported as stale (annotation, never a failure) so the list only shrinks. A project not in recordedOn (WebKit mobile-390 until its CI run is folded in) reports its new signatures without failing. Signatures carry no text: tag + first classes (CSS-module hash dropped) + type/role, anchored to the nearest classed ancestor. Every entry is known debt, not an approval: /rankings' watch star (17x13) and value button (34x15) are page-module controls (app/rankings/board.module.css) and the /market/sharp-people header links (17px) are page-local links; each belongs to its route's UI Lane 6 migration.
